svg.title: Defence in depth: what stops a participant at each layer
svg.desc: Six nested layers: Safe Exam Browser, Cloudflare WAF and rate limit, the app's deny-by-default route policy and sessions, the token ledger and tutor guardrails, the database roles and append-only tables, and the docker-proxy sandbox.
svg.text: DEFENCE IN DEPTH · assume every layer above has failed

g.text: 1 · Safe Exam Browser
2 · Cloudflare edge
3 · App policy + sessions
4 · Ledger + tutor guard
5 · DB roles
6 · Sandbox
untrusted code
lives only here
Kiosk, Config-Key hash on every request
no other apps, no paste/copy in the editor, quit password
WAF rejects contest paths without SEB
login + password change: 60 per 10 s per IP; TLS; no open ports
Deny-by-default route table, role per prefix
SEB hash re-checked in the app; one live session per participant;
logins slowed, never refused; strong passwords enforced
Tokens reserved before the model is called
gateway refuses oversize prompts; the tutor never sees code;
server filter removes code blocks over 3 lines
Each service its own Postgres role
audit_log + token_ledger reject UPDATE/DELETE by trigger;
unclassified tables get no grants; only migrate owns the schema
docker-proxy rebuilds every container
--network=none, read-only, uid 65534, no capabilities, memory/pid/CPU caps;
tampering with the runner yields IE, never Accepted
